objective: Repair BUKLOD MAIN Genesis Organization/Cluster audio and video call authentication after Stream JWT expiration without altering PTT, consent, ads, navigation, native runtime, or production.

chosenApproach: Reject expired or uninspectable Stream/Supabase JWTs, refresh once through Supabase session provider, never fall back to stale Stream tokens, retain SDK tokenProvider, and show actionable Tagalog guidance.
selectionRationale: Stream token endpoint issues one-hour credentials while the existing native client caches by age and previously fell back to stale tokens after refresh failure.

Disable Stream JWT validation or bypass permissions (rejected).
Force disconnect live PTT or native rebuild (rejected).
